claims.citation: New York Herald, 9 May 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Palmyra (Br), Watson, Liverpool April 25 via
Queenstown 26th, with mdse and passengers, to E Cunard.
April 30, lat 48 3, lon 36 23, exchanged signals with ship Ab-
botsford, bound E.
